text: カビゴンは　ねぼけて　おそってきた！

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form says the action comes toward the speaker. おそってきた = 'came at us attacking'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, here giving the state it was in when it did the next thing. ねぼけて = 'being half asleep'.
